A1.justification: Both PDFs describe the same research work and contain readable text, equations, figures, tables, and Appendices A–H. Full-document text and visual comparisons reveal no material evidence gaps.

before.justification: v1 reports original connectivity-inference and spike-prediction experiments on simulated ring networks, plus analysis of recordings from 19 mouse head-direction cells (Section 4, Tables 1–3, Figures 2–6).

after.justification: v2 retains the original simulation experiments and analysis of mouse head-direction recordings, including the same quantitative results and inferred connectivity profiles.

M1.justification: The dual-module GNN, Poisson objective, external-input embeddings, and interpolation of hidden-neuron embeddings are unchanged. Rewording in Sections 3.2.2–3.2.3 preserves the existing procedures.

E1.justification: Both versions use the same threshold-crossing and LNP simulations, external-input and partial-observation scenarios, and recordings of 19 mouse head-direction cells. No dataset or task coverage changes.

E2.justification: GLM, seqNMF, and TCA remain the evaluated comparators in Tables 1–3 and Figures 2–3, with unchanged implementations in Appendix C. The NetFormer and AMAG discussions also remain unchanged.

E3.justification: Both retain eight-minute simulations at 0.1 ms resolution, 80/10/10 data splits, the same observed/hidden-neuron configurations, and the same inference-error and spike-prediction metrics. Evaluation procedures in the appendices are identical.

E4.justification: The connectivity-profile comparisons, observed/hidden-neuron sensitivity analysis, and Figure 4 interpolation/shuffling control are unchanged. No ablation, robustness test, or supplementary analysis is added or removed.

E5.justification: Three-trial averaging, different random initializations, and standard-deviation bands/error bars remain unchanged in Tables 1–3 and Figures 2 and 4. No statistical reporting practice is revised.

E6.justification: Tables 1–3 and Figures 2–6 retain identical results and findings. For example, Table 1 still reports GNN normalized inference errors of 0.061 for threshold-crossing data and 0.049 for LNP data.

T1.justification: Mathematical definitions, assumptions, equations, and appendix derivations are unchanged. The revised GRU explanation introduces no new mathematical reasoning or formal property.

C1.justification: The abstract replaces the claim that the model 'consistently outperforms standard baselines' with a statement that it reliably resolves spurious correlations and recovers accurate weight profiles. This removes an explicit broad superiority claim; the main contributions and introduction/discussion claims remain unchanged.

C2.justification: Interpretations of spurious correlations, external-input effects, and hidden-neuron tradeoffs are unchanged. Section 5 retains the same applicability discussion and limitations concerning fixed connectivity, circuit topology, and non-unique inferred circuitry.

D1.justification: Architecture details, hyperparameters, baseline pseudocode, preprocessing, and data-source information are unchanged. Appendix H retains the same disclosure of approximately seven GPU days on V100 32GB GPUs using PyTorch and PyG.

R1.justification: The same 47 works are cited, with unchanged research positioning. Reference edits concern capitalization, publisher formatting, and correction of the ℓ1 typography in reference 26, rather than additions or removals of cited work.

P1.justification: Localized rewrites affect the abstract, the introduction's transductive-learning explanation, and Sections 3.2.2–3.2.3. References receive copyediting; section organization and appendix prose remain unchanged.

P2.justification: There are small line-wrapping and page-break adjustments, including a related-work line moving from page 3 to page 2, plus reference typesetting changes. Figures, tables, and algorithm displays retain their content and design.

improvement.justification: The narrower abstract better matches the scope of the comparative evidence: Tables 1–3 compare baselines under full observation, whereas Section 4.4 varies hidden-neuron configurations without those baseline comparisons. This modest improvement in claim calibration accompanies limited prose and reference corrections. Methods, results, substantive limitations, and all appendices remain unchanged.
